records.body:
Hi Rafael,

Thanks,

records.text: :tada: New signup: *Clearwater Systems* just joined on the starter plan!

decisions.rationale: Six days in with no project, no invite, no milestone, and zero replies to two outreach emails (email:7177ad9f, email:483bf9d9) or tickets. Silent, fully unengaged Starter accounts rarely self-activate in the remaining 8 days, though it's still possible.

draft.subject: Getting Clearwater Systems started in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Rafael,

Following up on my note last week — no pressure if things have been busy. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, so that's usually the easiest place to begin.

If it's helpful, I'm happy to hop on a short call this week and walk through setting up your first project together. Just reply with a couple of times that suit you and I'll work around them.

Best,
Chidi
